preconditions.description: The input size n must be between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: All elements in the sequence must be positive integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: not any(a[i] == a[i+1] for i in range(len(a)-1))
postconditions.description: The output sequence must not contain any pair of equal consecutive elements.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()[1:]) == k and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: The output must consist of exactly k integers (as specified in the first line), each between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: k == len(a) - (sum(1 for i in range(len(a)-1) if a[i] == a[i+1]) // 2)
postconditions.description: The output length k must equal the initial length minus the number of operations performed (each operation reduces length by 1).

postconditions.expression: all(a[i] == b[i] for i in range(min(len(a), len(b)))) if len(a) == len(b) else False
postconditions.description: If no operations are performed (no consecutive duplicates), the output sequence must match the input sequence exactly.
